item.title: “This is my belief, or overconfidence”- Riyan Parag says he can play both white-ball formats for India
item.description: Riyan Parag, the Assamese all-rounder, hasn't played for India in over a year but feels he can play both white-ball forms for the Men in Blue, but isn't now part of the national setup due to a shoulder injury. Riyan's only ODI appearance was against Sri Lanka in August 2024, and his most recent T20I was played at home against Bangladesh in October of last year. item.title: IND v SA 2025: WATCH- Massive crowds outside Barabati stadium cause chaos for tickets for first T20I in Cuttack
item.description: The Barabati Stadium in Cuttack, which will host the first T20I between India and South Africa on December 9, saw a huge crowd conjure for tickets that led to chaos erupting as police forces tried to bring order. Fans started assembling after midnight, causing severe congestion by dawn, even though police forbade overnight lines and only permitted lines to form starting at six in the morning. item.description: Former India head coach Ravi Shastri stated that people should avoid interfering with players like Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma, stressing that if the pair ‘hit the right switches’, those targeting them will disappear, issuing a strong warning to all detractors. item.title: “It was SRK’s suggestion”- KKR CEO reveals Shah Rukh Khan advised Andre Russell to retire from IPL
item.description: Although there were ongoing talks with Andre Russell over his release from the team before the IPL 2026 mini auction, Venky Mysore, CEO of the Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR), has disclosed that co-owner Shah Rukh Khan came up with the notion for Russell to retire from IPL but maintain ties to the team. Russell was let go by KKR before the December 16 IPL 2026 auction after 12 seasons with the team. item.description: India women’s team vice-captain Smriti Mandhana appeared in a video on social media in a collab with Colgate India. item.description: India’s assistant coach Ryan ten Doeschate on Friday (December 5) admitted that there is a slight “desperation” in the Indian camp to win the ongoing ODI series against South Africa after a below-par outing in the Test series. item.title: “If team management feels…,” Riyan Parag breaks silence on prospect of him becoming RR skipper after Samson’s exit
item.description: Ahead of the IPL 2026 retention deadline last month, a high-profile transfer deal took place involving Chennai Super Kings (CSK) and Rajasthan Royals (RR). As part of the trade agreement, Sanju Samson joined CSK while RR received the services of Ravindra Jadeja and Sam Curran.
